shadows.purpose: The gradient hero card's singular heavier shadow.

shadows.purpose: Soft colored glow under the primary button.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action per screen (log an entry, save a form).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid #0879bd; border-radius: 11px; padding: 11px 16px; background: #0879bd; color: #fff; font: inherit; font-weight: 750; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(8,121,189,.18); cursor: pointer; transition: .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #075d92; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(8,121,189,.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default button style for any action that isn't the primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid #e0eaf1; border-radius: 11px; padding: 11px 16px; background: #fff; color: #172534; font: inherit; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; transition: .15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #bdd8e7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(8,121,189,.2); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Read-only category label shown on a logged entry.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e8f5fc; color: #075d92; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 850; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Toggleable substance filter; active state fills with the substance's assigned accent color via --chip-color.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { padding: 5px 12px; border: 1px solid #e0eaf1; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: #687988; font-size: .74rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: .12s ease; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { border-color: var(--chip-color, #0879bd); color: var(--chip-color, #0879bd); } .ds-filter-chip--active { border-color: var(--chip-color, #0879bd); background: var(--chip-color, #0879bd); color: #fff; }

components.name: Panel / Card
components.description: The default container for any grouped content.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #e0eaf1; border-radius: 18px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(20,65,96,.07); } .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 6px; color: #0879bd; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 850; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.08rem; letter-spacing: -.025em; }

components.name: Entry Card
components.description: A single logged entry in a list; lifts and deepens its shadow on hover.
components.css: .ds-entry { padding: 17px 19px; border: 1px solid #e0eaf1; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(20,65,96,.04); cursor: pointer; transition: .15s ease; } .ds-entry:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(20,65,96,.07); border-color: #bdd8e7; } .ds-entry h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-entry time { color: #687988; font-size: .84rem; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Mutually-exclusive choice control (date range, entry mode) — a white pill slides under the active option inside a light gray track.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: flex; gap: 3px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid #d7e5ed; border-radius: 13px; background: #eaf3f8; } .ds-segmented__btn { padding: 7px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #637786; font-size: .74rem; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented__btn:hover { color: #075d92; background: rgba(255,255,255,.55); } .ds-segmented__btn--active { color: #075d92; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(20,65,96,.1); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field with a soft blue focus ring.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Notiz<input type="text" class="ds-input" placeholder="Was ist dir aufgefallen?"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #526576; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 750; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #d7e3eb; border-radius: 11px; padding: 11px 12px; background: #fbfdff; color: #172534; font: inherit; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(8,121,189,.12); border-color: #0879bd; }

components.name: Crisis Card
components.description: Always-visible emergency-help card; deliberately its own color family, never the destructive red.
components.html:
Nicht auf einen Eintrag warten

Bei akuter Selbst- oder Fremdgefährdung sofort Hilfe holen.

Notruf 112
components.css: .ds-crisis { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #efc8d2; border-radius: 18px; background: #fff8fa; } .ds-crisis h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #962b46; font-size: 1.08rem; } .ds-crisis p { margin: 0 0 12px; color: #684852; font-size: .84rem; } .ds-crisis__action { display: inline-block; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 11px; background: #962b46; color: #fff; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; }

narrative.overview: KLARA sits with the user without ever raising its voice. The interface's job is to disappear into the moment of writing something down — a calm blue-and-white surface, generous rounding, soft diffuse shadows, one typeface at every weight it needs and no more. Nothing in the system scores, counts up dramatically, or celebrates; the one place color gets expressive is the gradient hero card that opens Start and Today, and even there it stays a gentle wash rather than a splash. The system deliberately avoids two failure modes at once: it must never read as a cold, sterile clinic interface, and it must never read as a playful habit-tracker with streaks and rewards — both would misrepresent what the product is for. Structure carries the seriousness (fixed five-part entry format, an always-visible crisis exit); color and shape carry the warmth.
keyCharacteristics: Calm clinical-blue palette on an off-white paper ground, never stark white-on-white
Soft, ambient shadows and consistently rounded corners (nothing sharp-edged)
One typeface (Inter), differentiated only by weight, size, and letter-spacing
A single gradient "hero" surface as the system's one moment of visual richness
A deliberately separate, muted rose family reserved only for crisis/emergency content

rules.name: The Cyan-Is-Not-Clickable Rule
rules.body: Cyan never appears on a button or any interactive control — it marks information, blue marks action.

rules.name: The Two Reds Rule
rules.body: Quiet Alert Red is reserved for a single destructive micro-interaction and must never flag or color-code a logged entry. Crisis Rose is its own separate family used only for the emergency-help card, so a life-safety signal never blends with an ordinary UI warning.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Inter is the only typeface in the system, at every weight from 400 to 900. A second typeface would read as decoration the product's tone doesn't want.

rules.name: The No Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow uses a wide blur radius and low opacity (≤0.2 alpha). A tight, dark, cut-out shadow never appears.

rules.name: The Segmented Pill Rule
rules.body: Any control offering a small set of mutually exclusive choices uses the same light-track/white-pill pattern; it must not be reinvented elsewhere.

dos: Do use Clinical Blue for every interactive element and Clinical Cyan only for data/decoration — keep the Cyan-Is-Not-Clickable Rule intact.
Do keep every new shape rounded (8px minimum radius) with soft, wide, low-opacity shadows.
Do treat the gradient hero as a singular, non-repeatable surface — one per view at most.
Do keep Crisis Rose visually and structurally separate from Quiet Alert Red.
donts: Don't use red, or any color, to flag, score, or visually shame a logged consumption entry — this is a durable product principle, not a stylistic preference.
Don't add gamification elements — streaks, badges, confetti, celebratory progress bars.
Don't let the interface drift toward a sterile, cold, stark-white "hospital" look.
Don't introduce a second display/personality typeface.
